sents.zh: 汉朝的时候，中国和西边的国家还很少来往。
sents.en: In the Han dynasty, China had little contact with the lands to the west.

sents.zh: 很多人不知道西边有什么。
sents.en: Many people did not know what lay to the west.

sents.zh: 后来，皇帝让一些人向西走，看一看那里的情况。
sents.en: Later the emperor sent men west to see what was there.

sents.zh: 他们走了很多年才回来。
sents.en: They travelled for many years before returning.

sents.zh: 回来以后，他们说西边有很多国家，也有很多新东西。
sents.en: On their return they said there were many countries to the west, and many new things.

sents.zh: 因为这样，中国的商人也开始向西走。
sents.en: Because of this, Chinese merchants began to travel west too.

sents.zh: 他们带着中国的丝，因为西边的人很喜欢它。
sents.en: They carried Chinese silk, because people in the west liked it very much.

sents.zh: 丝又轻又好看，而且不重，可以带很远。
sents.en: Silk is light and beautiful, and not heavy, so it can be carried far.

sents.zh: 路上有山，也有很热的地方，非常难走。
sents.en: The road crossed mountains and very hot places, and was hard going.

sents.zh: 一次来回常常要一两年。
sents.en: One round trip often took a year or two.

sents.zh: 西边来的商人也带来了东西。
sents.en: Merchants from the west brought things too.

sents.zh: 他们带来了马，还有新的水果。
sents.en: They brought horses, and new fruits.

sents.zh: 不只是东西，想法也从这条路走过来走过去。
sents.en: Not only goods but ideas travelled back and forth along this road.

sents.zh: 因为丝是路上最有名的东西，所以后来叫它丝绸之路。
sents.en: Because silk was the most famous thing on it, the road came to be called the Silk Road.

sents.zh: 这条路让中国和很远的地方连在了一起。
sents.en: This road joined China to places very far away.
